Topics · The holy books together

Do Quran, Torah and Gospel share one source?

The agreement is plain and the Quran declares it. Three explanations: conscience, neighbours, and one sender.

Part 1 of 3

﴿يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

O you who have believed, decreed upon you is fasting as it was decreed upon those before you that you may become righteous -

Quran · Maryam 19:31

Translation

But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.

Original · Ancient Greek

αὐτὸς δὲ ἦν ὑποχωρῶν ἐν ταῖς ἐρήμοις καὶ προσευχόμενος.

the Gospel (Luke) · 5:16

World English Bible

Some of the agreement is not hidden. The verse on fasting says it was prescribed for you as for those before you. Jesus, in the Quran, says he was charged with prayer and giving as long as he lives. Prayer, giving, fasting: the Quran presents its worship as an old inheritance. The Jews and Christians of his world practised these things, so these commands were no secret in Arabia. The honest claim is that they agree, and that the Quran says so. Why would they?

A question for you

Which of these acts of worship do you know from your own tradition?

If you sayPrayer.
ThenThen you have stood where they stood.
If you sayFasting.
ThenThen you know what the word 'as' means in that verse.
If you sayGiving in secret.
ThenThe books agree closely on that. See the texts after this Step.
If you sayNone of them.
ThenThat is fine. It is enough to see the agreement among those who keep them.

Translator's notes

Quran · Al-Ma'idah 5:46

Translation

For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

Original · Hebrew

כִּ֤י נֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה וְת֣וֹרָה א֑וֹר וְדֶ֥רֶךְ חַ֝יִּ֗ים תּוֹכְח֥וֹת מוּסָֽר׃

Proverbs · 6:23

World English Bible

The Quran describes a chain with one word: confirming. Jesus came confirming the Torah. The Gospel confirmed it too. This book came confirming what was before it. Each link points back. Ask any of them why they agree, and the answer is one: we have one sender. That is an open claim. It also explains something: why agreement would be expected, and why the last link would announce it and not hide it.

A question for you

How do you read the word 'confirming'?

If you sayA claim to win trust.
ThenA critic may read it so. Then ask what a book risks by inviting its reader to compare.
If you sayA description of something visible.
ThenThe agreement can indeed be seen. What explains it remains, and that is the next part.

Part 3 of 3

World English Bible

Now weigh three explanations. Conscience: people everywhere know theft is shameful, and that explains much. Neighbours: the Prophet lived in a world with Jews and Christians, and that explains much too. One sender: the Quran's own claim. The verse sums up what all were commanded: worship God sincerely, pray, give. Conscience explains honesty better than it explains one God. Neighbours explain a line better than a lifetime's message. One sender explains the agreement, if you grant a sender. Weigh the three.

A question for you

Which explanation carries most weight for you now?

If you sayConscience.
ThenThen weigh whether conscience reaches one God and prayer, and where conscience itself came from.
If you sayNeighbours.
ThenThen the Step on the teacher gives that view in full, with the Quran's answer.
If you sayOne sender.
ThenThen the question left is what follows from that.
If you saySome mix of these.
ThenThat is possible. Gather all the strands in one place.
